$comment: plugin-upgrade self-upgrade e2e run report. One file per run, filled from the run's own artifacts — see runs/ for a filled baseline. The fixture is frozen, so reports are comparable across skill iterations. Any field that cannot be measured in a given run MUST be the string "unavailable" plus a sibling `<field>UnavailableReason` explaining why — never invent a number.
skillVersion: <version of the installed @khorsheed/dsh-plugin-upgrade the run exercised>

tokens.$comment: read from the upgrade session's projection cache ($DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json, rows.tokenUsage.val.totals) or an equivalent host meter; NOT from the driver, which sees none

wallTime.$comment: seconds; toRestarted = one sentence sent -> supervisor verdict upgraded; total = sentence -> post-restart verification reported

toolCalls.$comment: tool/call entries in the session log, total and per tool name

changeSurface.$comment: product-affecting edits the upgrading agent made (fixture fix + profile re-point), not its scratch scripts

humanInterventions.$comment: count of operator actions the run could not have completed without (excluding environment setup); list each

fleetVerification.$comment: the four-driver assert verdicts plus browser-level marker check

feedbackBoardNotes: <integer: notes the upgrading agent left in $DSH_HOME/skill-feedback/plugin-upgrade/ during the run>
